mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with improved corporate earnings within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous three months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with increased economic activity within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with improved corporate earnings within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5pp does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the previous two months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points in the same period, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with a strong consumer-driven economy within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with improved consumer confidence within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% over the previous month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment with high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with a restrictive monetary policy environment within 6 months.
